notes: [p]Hi folks, weekend Casey here,[/p][p][/p][p]A small update for some quick fixes, some icons for Dread, and a translation update.[/p][p]No big changes, have a nice weekend.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]ART:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added icons for the following Dread powers:[/p][list][*][p][b]Aeonglass Dominion[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosive[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Insatiable Dominion[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Lagavulin Matriarch Dominion[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]You Are Mine[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Arrows now stick to the body of every enemy instead of its center[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]WRITING:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Polished the text of some of the Fool's epochs[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/h2][p][b]General:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the timeline getting stuck when opening some of the Fool's epochs in Turkish[/p][/*][*][p]Viewing a damaged run in Run History no longer adds duplicate copies of it[/p][/*][*][p]Card previews no longer cover a potion's text when hovering it on an epoch's potion unlock screen[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a duplicate tooltip from the [b]Insatiable Dominion[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in one of the Fool's epoch descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Japanese Arrow tooltip showing broken text when you have no Arrows[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Traditional Chinese text that always showed the plural wording[/p][/*][*][p]Updated translations and fixed broken formatting in several languages[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Fool:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Stretch[/b] now adds to the Block from [b]Adroit[/b] on cards that don't gain Block themselves, like [b]Ki Hop[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Show Off+[/b]'s upgrade preview no longer highlights its Aim in green, which the upgrade does not change[/p][/*][/list]
